name: flowdeck
description: FlowDeck workflow (fixed pipeline, guarded state) ported to Claude Code.

model_profile.title: Agent models
model_profile.description: inherit: every agent on your session model. optimized: mapper and researcher on haiku, coder and tester on sonnet, the rest on your model. reduced: every agent one step below your model (haiku at the floor). No agent runs above your session model.

models.title: Per-agent model overrides
models.description: Optional, e.g. coder=opus,mapper=haiku. Agents: mapper, researcher, architect, planner, coder, tester, reviewer, security-auditor, debug-specialist. Models: haiku, sonnet, opus, fable. Still capped at your session model.

storage.title: Where FlowDeck keeps plans and state
storage.description: home: ~/.fd-plan/<project>/. project: <project>/.fd-plan/ (git-ignored by its own .gitignore; delete that file to commit your plans). Switching does not move existing state.

stage_skills.title: Extra skills per stage
stage_skills.description: Optional skills a stage runs at a fixed point, e.g. review=ponytail:ponytail-audit,verify=simplify. Stages: task, review, execute, verify, done; repeat a stage for more than one skill. Findings are reported as advisory and never block the stage.
